meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划交给它,自动拆成并行任务并逐步跑完
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有详细计划但不想手动一项项执行。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan to completion with parallel tasks and tracked progress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want it executed without doing each step by hand.

howto.what: Claude 不再自己写代码,而是充当编排者:选出 .omo/plans 下的工作计划,把每个勾选项拆成子任务派给子智能体并行执行,自己只维护 .omo/ 状态(计划勾选、证据台账、worktree)。
howto.when: 当你说 ulw-execute,或要求运行 .omo/plans 里的计划时接管。若没有可选的计划,会先调用 ulw-plan 生成一份计划再开始执行。

say.note: 选中 .omo/plans 下的计划并开始跑
每个阶段的工作以 PR 交付
PR 开好后一直跟到合并完成

howto.what_en: Claude stops coding itself and acts as an orchestrator: it picks a plan under .omo/plans, splits each checkbox into sub-tasks for parallel subagents, and only keeps .omo/ state (plan checkboxes, evidence ledger, worktrees).
howto.when_en: Takes over when you say ulw-execute or ask to run a plan in .omo/plans. If no plan is selectable, it first calls ulw-plan to create one, then executes.

say_en.note: Selects a plan under .omo/plans and starts
Each phase's work is delivered as a PR
Stays on the job until the PR is merged
